title: Inert-operad algebras are color diagrams without presentability
statement:
Use the universe, quasicategory and monoidal infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], the generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability], using only its definitions, and inert base maps of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]. Let $p:\mathcal M\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ be a small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad whose zero-fiber is a Kan complex. Let $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}_{\mathrm{int}}$ have all objects of $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ and precisely its inert arrows. Put
$$\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}=\mathcal M\times_{\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}}\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}_{\mathrm{int}},$$
viewed over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ via the inclusion, and let $\tau:\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}\to\mathcal M$ be the projection. Then $\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}$ is a small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad, $\tau$ preserves inert arrows, and its zero-fiber map is the identity of $\mathcal M_{[0]}$. For every monoidal infinity category $\mathcal V$, with no cocompleteness or presentability assumption, evaluation on the fiber over $[1]$ induces an equivalence
$$E_{\mathcal V}:\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}}(\mathcal V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},\mathcal V).$$
This equivalence is natural under inert-preserving precomposition in $\mathcal M$ and lax monoidal postcomposition in $\mathcal V$, including coherent transformations and their higher homotopies. In particular, for a lax monoidal $F:\mathcal V\to\mathcal W$, if $F_*^{\mathrm{triv}}$ is postcomposition on inert-operad algebras and $G=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},F)$, then $E_{\mathcal W}F_*^{\mathrm{triv}}\simeq GE_{\mathcal V}$, and $E_{\mathcal V}\tau^*$ is the functor evaluating an $\mathcal M$-algebra on its colors.
